title: Project or domain claim
description: A typed statement owned by a project's truth layer or by a domain package. The kind determines binding force and who may change it. User preferences are NOT claims (see knowledge-entry). See docs/KNOWLEDGE_TAXONOMY.md.

owner.description: project:<id> or domain:<id>. Domain-owned claims apply to every project using that domain unless the project tightens them.

created_by.description: billy | orchestrator | role id. project_requirement and hard_constraint require billy (or kernel/domain security policy for constraints).

evidence.description: IDs: EVD-, DEC-, ADR-, CTX- (CTX only as evidence).

review_trigger.description: For assumptions/hypotheses: what observation would invalidate or confirm it.

enforced_by.description: Gate or policy-guard rule IDs that enforce this claim (hard constraints especially).
